company.description:
Brands spend millions in advertising and people end up skipping them.

7amdaan.io is an interactive robotics solution company in the AdTech Space specialized in OOH Advertising. To help these Brands we've built Screens on Wheels called Robotizer.

Robotizer is a Self-moving Autonomous Device that can be deployed both Indoors/Outdoors.

It serves Brands, Events and Government Sectors. The autonomous 'Robotizer' is going to help brands to connect with humans.
